name: HiveMind
notes: The Bloom tab now has a draft bloom calendar for your own area anywhere in the US: 253 natural regions, including NC's mountains, Piedmont and outer coastal plain, fitted to your apiary's freeze dates.
The NC Sandhills keep The Bee Guy's reviewed calendar. Drafts are marked, and come from iNaturalist flowering records.
Inspections now have a time. The weather fills in for that hour at the apiary, even when you type the inspection in later at home.
